what: M44: the Search-R1 style search policy of app/rl, trained once with a LoRA adapter and scored on fixture v1's held-out questions against the same model untrained and against single-shot RAG
decoding: greedy (argmax; no temperature, top-k, top-p or repetition penalty)

licence.source: Hugging Face API (<path>/models<id>: tag license:apache-2.0, card licence apache-2.0), read 2026-11-22
licence.skipped: Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, the size PLAN.md Phase 10 names: licence `other` (qwen-research, non-commercial)

environment.index: the in-memory hybrid index over the question's corpus: BM25 and bge-small lists fused with RRF, no router, no reranker (the benchmark's hybrid@bge-small construction)

reward.formula: R = 1.0 * em + 0.5 * nDCG@10(files shown, in order of first appearance; gold paths) - 0.1 * n_search - 1.0 * uncited_or_empty
reward.jury_term: none: PLAN.md Phase 10's 0.3 * jury vote is not in this reward (no jury runs in the loop)
reward.em: strict: the answer with its bracketed citations removed equals the gold answer after normalisation (lower case, whitespace collapsed, surrounding quotes and a final full stop dropped, standalone numbers compared as numbers)
reward.em_bounded: guard column, never the reward: app.eval.judge.exact_match_label(bounded=True) is "correct" for the answer without its citations (the gold is somewhere in it, not inside a longer number or word); it credits a verbose answer and a list of candidates
reward.cited: a bracketed path in the answer is one of the files this episode's searches showed
reward.uncited_or_empty: no <answer>, an answer with no value outside its citations, or not cited
reward.n_search: searches the environment ran, the single-shot arm's own search included

bar.declared: before the first training run (milestone notes, 2026-11-22, section 1)
bar.questions: fixture v1's held-out half: the `test` half of app.eval.rerank_arms.split_questions, the half rrf_sweep holds out
bar.comparison: trained policy minus untrained policy, same model, prompt, environment and questions, greedy decoding
bar.primary: the paired bootstrap delta in exact match (`em`)
bar.secondary: the same delta in mean reward; and both again against single-shot RAG
bar.reading: a 95% interval above zero is a win, one that covers zero is a tie, one below zero is a loss
bar.seeds: with several training seeds a question's trained score is the mean over the seeds (exact match in thirds), and the verdict is read from that row; every seed's own delta is in the table
bar.checkpoint: per seed, the saved checkpoint with the highest mean reward on the TUNE half, greedy; a tie goes to the earliest step; step 0 is not eligible
bar.collapse: a run has collapsed when its loss is not finite, or fewer than 0.5 of the last 20 steps' episodes hold an answer, or the mean episode reward of its last 20 steps is more than 0.1 below that of its first 20; a collapsed GRPO run is followed by one PPO-clip run

algorithm.name: grpo
algorithm.label: a policy gradient with GRPO's group-normalised advantage: per question, the group's mean reward is the baseline and its standard deviation the scale; no critic
algorithm.not: one optimiser step per batch of episodes, so the PPO ratio GRPO clips is identically 1 and nothing is clipped; no KL term; not the veRL stack PLAN.md names, a small loop on transformers and peft
algorithm.loss: minus the advantage times the mean log-probability of the tokens the policy wrote; the prompt and every <information> block are context only

bootstrap.method: percentile bootstrap over queries, one index matrix shared by all configs (paired deltas)

split.rule: alternate train / test inside each category, gold order (app.eval.rerank_arms.split_questions)

held_out_gold_forms.rule: single_value: one token with no comma or semicolon; composite: anything else

training_corpora.command: python -m app.rl.corpora --seeds <seeds> --out <a directory outside the repository>

leakage.rule_a: dropped: normalised text (lower case, whitespace collapsed) equals a fixture v1 question's, tune or held-out half
leakage.rule_b: dropped: the answer is a constant of the builder, the same string for every corpus (it would teach a held-out gold string under strict exact match); counted after rule (a)

kept_answers_equal_to_a_fixture_answer.note: a kept training answer that is also some fixture answer: short values a corpus must be read for (a pair count, a learning rate, yes / no); none is a phrase

leakage.templates_shared_with_fixture_v1: every kept training question is built from a template that also builds fixture v1 questions: same wording, other run ids, names and values

does_not_show: Synthetic corpora: training and test corpora come from one builder (bench/corpus/build.py); nothing here is a real research directory.

Templated questions: every training question is built from a template that also builds test questions (same wording, other run ids, names and values), so a gain may be a gain on these templates only. The test questions whose template had no training question are listed under `leakage`.
One small model (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct with a LoRA adapter) and one prompt: no model sweep, no prompt sweep.
One test corpus of 61 files and 68 held-out questions, 40 of them the per-run lookups; the tune half of the same corpus chose the checkpoint.

Strict exact match can move on answer format alone; `em_bounded` and the answer length are the guard columns, and composite gold answers (a list, a sentence, two values joined by a semicolon) are counted apart from single values.
No jury term in the reward, and no judge of answer quality beyond exact match.
Greedy decoding on one GPU type: the episodes are stored, and every number is recomputed from them, but regenerating them on other hardware may not reproduce every token.
